Name: Calendar Buffs
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Includes the following:
[list]
[*]Bookseller is in town
[*]Festivals, standard and custom
[*]Passive festivals, standard and custom
[/list]
You can edit the config.json file to change which icons are displayed.
[list]
[*]Icons can be specified like "102" (index within [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Objects/Object_sprites]Maps\springobjects[/url]﻿) or "TileSheets\\Objects_2:134" (index within specified tilesheet)
[*]Festivals will also look for an attribute "JohnPeters.CalendarBuffs/BuffIcon" within festival data
[*]Passive festivals will also look for an attribute "JohnPeters.CalendarBuffs/BuffIcon" within passive festival "CustomFields" data - see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35192]Grape Day[/url]﻿ for an example
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/emurphy42/CalendarBuffs]Source code[/url]

Manifest.Name: Calendar Buffs
Manifest.Description: Displays buff icons to remind you of all-day events.
